invariantStatements.I01-human-unscorable-is-not-model-absten: Human-unscorable ground truth is not model abstention.
invariantStatements.I02-classification-uses-S-and-U-I-unsupp: Classification quality uses human-scorable truth; unsupported assertions on U and I are measured separately.
invariantStatements.I04-track-calibration-is-post-aggregatio: Track calibration is evaluated after aggregation and abstention.
invariantStatements.I05-calibration-fit-is-training-only: Calibration fitting uses training-derived predictions only; tuning, selection and frozen-test data cannot fit calibration coefficients.
invariantStatements.I06-tuning-selects-operating-parameters-: Tuning chooses operating parameters; selection compares frozen configurations and performs no fitting or tuning.
invariantStatements.I07-frozen-test-cannot-select-or-rescue-: Frozen-test evidence cannot tune, rank, replace or rescue a candidate, and a failed or inconclusive frozen qualification cannot trigger adaptive alternative selection on the same exposed test.
invariantStatements.I08-comparison-is-paired-cluster-aware-a: Candidate comparison is paired and cluster-aware, and every Track's crops stay together.
invariantStatements.I09-practical-noninferiority-equivalence: Practical-difference, non-inferiority and equivalence margins are predeclared before selection.
invariantStatements.I10-interval-overlap-is-not-equivalence: Interval overlap is not equivalence, and non-significance is not non-inferiority.
invariantStatements.I11-insufficient-support-remains-insuffi: Insufficient attribute/value support or independent-cluster support remains insufficient evidence and cannot become a pass, tie or statistical winner.
invariantStatements.I12-unconditional-recall-includes-absten: Unconditional recall already includes abstention, so coverage is not multiplied into recall-support arithmetic a second time.
invariantStatements.I13-owner-numerical-targets-are-not-inve: S2c.2b-1 does not invent owner numerical quality targets; it freezes only the form and authority of those gates.
invariantStatements.I14-operational-pareto-fleet-final-order: Whole-job CPU/host gates, composition resource accounting, 10k-Track deadline mechanics, 500-camera projection, Pareto axes and deterministic final technical ordering remain S2c.2b-2 scope.

partitionStatements.calibrationCoefficients: training-derived, group-disjoint held-out predictions or predeclared cross-fitting
partitionStatements.poolingParameters: tuning, within the family frozen before candidate execution
